layouts.map: COMPOSITION: a wide, opaque, painted night-time landscape seen from slightly above, filling the whole canvas edge to edge. A single continuous dirt trail runs from the far LEFT edge to the far RIGHT edge through three neighbourhoods in order, left to right: Pumpkin Fields, Hollow Woods and The Graveyard. A full moon and starry sky at the top.
layouts.fog_black: COMPOSITION: a full-frame painted texture of fog only, filling the whole canvas edge to edge, evenly spread across the frame with no single focal point, no objects, no horizon and no vignette, so it can be tiled.
layouts.meter_track:
COMPOSITION: one long, thin, horizontal rail running straight across almost the full width of the canvas (a small margin at both ends), centred vertically, seen straight-on, about 1/10 of the canvas height.
BACKGROUND: plain, flat, solid light grey (#D0D0D0), perfectly uniform.
layouts.meter_fill:
COMPOSITION: one straight, horizontal band running edge to edge across the FULL width of the canvas with no ends, centred vertically, about 1/10 of the canvas height. No rail, no frame, no container.
BACKGROUND: plain, flat, pure black (#000000).
layouts.g3:
COMPOSITION: the whole figure walking, facing RIGHT in a 3/4 side view, filling about 88% of the canvas height, centred, feet at the bottom centre with a small soft oval shadow beneath them, nothing cropped. Bold silhouette that reads clearly at 128 px.
BACKGROUND: plain, flat, solid light grey (#D0D0D0), perfectly uniform.
layouts.scene_popup: COMPOSITION: a wide, opaque, painted scene used as the header image of a popup. The LEFT HALF of the image stays very dark (deep night purple-navy, nearly empty, no important detail) so a headline can sit over it; all the detail sits in the right half. The image fills the canvas edge to edge.
layouts.scene_shop: COMPOSITION: a wide, opaque, painted banner scene. The LEFT 55% stays dark (deep night purple-navy, nearly empty, no important detail) for the live title and Candy balance; all the detail sits in the right 45%. The image fills the canvas edge to edge.

d1.name: Desktop from guide
d1.prefix: The FIRST attached image is a flat LAYOUT GUIDE. Paint the final map following it EXACTLY: the trail follows the beige line, and the TWELVE brown ovals are empty, flat, round clearings of bare ground at exactly those positions and sizes. Keep all twelve, each clearly empty with nothing on it. The coloured bands mark the three neighbourhoods: orange = Pumpkin Fields, green = Hollow Woods, pink-red = The Graveyard. The dark band is sky. The SECOND attached image is the approved concept: match its art style, the huge full moon, the layered hills and the faint neon-lime glow edging the trail.
d1.subject: Make it SPOOKY: a dark, moody night with low drifting ground mist, dead twisted trees, crooked leaning fences, crows on bare branches, eerie glowing jack-o'-lantern faces in the pumpkin patch, cracked gravestones and a looming gothic gate. Each neighbourhood carries a subtle glow in its colour (orange, ghostly green, pink-red), but the ground stays dark and natural; do not flood it with colour. No text, labels or lettering anywhere.
